The report says 'The Company is controlled through weighted voting rights.' The WVR beneficiaries are Lei Jun (4,068,513,104 Class A shares, about 61.9% of votes on ordinary matters) and co-founder Lin Bin (448,997,030 Class A shares, about 6.8%). All Class A shares together equal 18.0% of issued share capital excluding treasury shares. Lei Jun's shares are held through trusts he settled for the benefit of himself and his family (ARK Trust (Hong Kong) Limited as trustee).

The report states Lei Jun's interests only as % of each share class, so leader.derived computes 24.12% of all issued shares (Class A plus Class B); pctEconomic is null. The denominators are the same class totals the report's own class percentages use (1,985,666,534 / 20,581,641,676 = 9.65%). pctVoting 61.9% is the report's figure for his Class A shares only on non-reserved matters; the report does not state a voting % that includes his Class B shares. The substantial-shareholder register lists only Lei Jun's own holding vehicles (Smart Mobile, Sunrise Vision, Parkway Global, ARK Trust); ARK Trust's 10.55% of Class B also includes 184,740,432 Class B shares held for other trusts, which is not added. LARGEST HOLDERS is empty: no other holder has a disclosed percentage of all shares. Co-founder and director Lin Bin is disclosed only per class (448,997,030 Class A, 9.94% of Class A, held by Apex Star LLC; plus Class B interests of 8.29%, 0.45%, 0.25% and 0.15% of Class B), and combining them would be a derivation the schema does not allow for holders. The 2024 Annual Report shows no other 5% holder. DIVIDENDS: none paid; the Board also resolved not to declare a final dividend for 2024. The RMB 23,286k paid to non-controlling interests is excluded. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line 'Payments for shares repurchase' (RMB 4,047,876k). The treasury-share note shows RMB 3,531,531k of shares repurchased in 2024 on a trade basis; the cash-flow figure is used. STOCK COMP: the Note 9 employee benefit line (RMB 3,726,085k).
